note: doc/phase3_5_tasks_and_acceptance.md section 6.1. Six sources, frozen: the seed, the sizes, the memory mode, the mask and the oracle. Sizes are NOT to be raised to make a result look better -- section 6.3 forbids changing the workload after a failure.

hardware_precondition.why: Section 5: the gains are measured on the accepted banked profile. The old core-sim is a compatibility regression only and cannot stand in for a real finite-port measurement.

workloads.name: masked AXPY
workloads.observe: a dynamic scalar, the tail block, and address arithmetic
workloads.oracle: x[i]*alpha + y[i] for i < n, in double, compared exactly after fp32 rounding

workloads.name: two outputs sharing one intermediate
workloads.formula: t = x*alpha; y = t + b; z = t - b
workloads.observe: CSE and mask reuse across two outputs; BOTH outputs are checked, so neither can be deleted to win

workloads.name: a legal view/layout composition, then elementwise
workloads.observe: layout-conversion elimination and the physical bank assignment
workloads.note: A predetermined ablation subject. It is reported whether or not it wins. If a pure rename is already free, it stays as a non-regression control -- the baseline is not made to carry data it never needed to move.

workloads.name: masked reduction
workloads.observe: dead pure-value elimination and live range, with the reduction order unchanged

workloads.name: FP16 GEMM
workloads.observe: TensorMap to VRF to MMA fragment layout, and what each conversion costs

workloads.name: FP16 GEMM, two-slot pipeline
workloads.observe: real bank conflicts, window lifetime and scheduling

primary.what: six workloads x B0/O2, all on the same banked candidate

ablation.what: L03 and L06 at O1 and at O2-no-LL; the O2 run is shared with the primary comparison

legacy_profile.what: L01 and L02 x B0/O1 on the same core-sim binary; compatibility only, not a gain gate

post_install.what: L01 at O2, one artifact and one session, three alphas
